purpose: Samsung Electronics only: test TeddyNote-style analog forecasts of next 20 trading-day cumulative price return
data: Frozen Naver daily prices 2019-01-02 through 2026-10-07; no interpolation or synthetic data
validation_library: For each validation year, use only historical episodes whose 20-day outcomes finished before the first validation signal of that year. Freeze this library throughout the year.
validation_queries: Signal dates in validation year, with full 20-day outcome also inside that year; common minimum 100-day observed history for all configurations
test_library: All eligible episodes with outcome before first 2026 signal; frozen, excludes every 2026 outcome
normalization: Min/max of each input window only, then unit L2 norm for cosine similarity; skip constant windows
episode_overlap: Greedily select by descending similarity; selected historical input-plus-outcome episodes cannot overlap (endpoint separation >= lookback+20)
fallback: If fewer than 3 independent episodes selected, predict the same common historical mean return as the mean baseline. Up probability also falls back to common historical up-rate.
direction_probability: Laplace-smoothed neighbor up frequency (up_count+1)/(neighbor_count+2), only if sufficient neighbors
selection: Lowest mean annual validation MAE over 2022-2025, all four years equal weight; ties resolved by deterministic configuration id. Freeze selection before test scoring. Test ranking cannot change selection.
diagnostic_reference: One 12-day input/0.98 cosine/mean configuration with overlapping matches allowed, on historical-only episodes. This is illustrative and excluded from selection. Raw reference daily-mean return and future-inclusive search are corrected.
metrics: matched-only error versus baseline on identical dates
dependence: Daily 20-day targets overlap. Show first-date anchored nonoverlapping results and a paired moving-block bootstrap of mean-baseline MAE minus selected MAE, block length 20, 2000 repeats, seed 42. Treat uncertainty as exploratory, not proof.
test_status: 2026 prices and earlier model results were already inspected in prior experiments. This is a follow-up holdout comparison, not a newly blinded confirmatory test. No 2026 data will be used for current parameter selection.
latest_prediction: Fixed selected configuration on latest completed snapshot close. Mark unverified future and explicitly identify fallback if no reliable analogs.
costs: Forecast accuracy experiment, not an executable trading strategy; no transaction-profit claim
limitations: Naver price adjustment unspecified and dividend cash flows excluded
model selection uncertainty not fully captured by bootstrap
historical similarity is not a success probability
